vectors.description: a condition exactly 256 nodes deep is read
a condition 257 nodes deep is rejected at its deepest node
the caller can lower the node depth
JSON nesting exactly at the limit
the bracket that exceeds the nesting limit
a document larger than the size limit
the node too deep is the first at depth limit + 1 in pre-order
the default JSON nesting limit is 1024
a field path of exactly 256 segments, keys and indexes, is read
a field path of 257 segments is rejected at its 257th segment
the caller can lower the path limit; payload values have it too
a path's segments are checked in order: the first segment beyond the limit comes before a malformed one after it
a malformed segment within the limit comes before the segment beyond it
the path limit is checked with the shape, before construction rules such as a negative index
a YAML beyond the size limit is limit_exceeded before its bytes are decoded, though they are not UTF-8
a rule text beyond the size limit is limit_exceeded before its bytes are decoded, though they are not UTF-8
a CSV text beyond the size limit is limit_exceeded before its bytes are decoded, though they are not UTF-8
a JSON text beyond the size limit is limit_exceeded before its bytes are decoded, though they are not UTF-8
bytes within the size limit that are not UTF-8 are a format_error at the line and column of the first invalid byte
